title: Avalon-MM agent: a 256-word memory with a wait-state window, read and write bursts of up to 16 beats with byte enables, pipelined read data

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: an access outside the memory, a burstcount above 16, or read and write asserted together; the core holds this until reset, so the bit cannot be cleared before then

notes: av_address, av_read, av_write, av_writedata, av_byteenable, av_burstcount, av_readdata, av_readdatavalid and av_waitrequest are the Avalon-MM agent pins; they pass through unchanged. The registers report the agent's error event.

Bytes 0x000 to 0x1FF answer without wait states; 0x200 to 0x3FF cost one wait state per command or write beat and one idle cycle before each read beat. Beats above 0x3FF are dropped (writes) or return 0 (reads). A burstcount of 0 is one beat, above 16 is clamped to 16. waitrequest stays high while read data is returned.
